Global PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 suppresses generated Python cache writes before source-freeze checks; it does not change the Rust feature, suite, query or scorer settings. New invocations additionally use -B.

Previously reviewed HTTP step is byte-identical, with pre-execution fixed driver hash/non-symlink check and receipt binding plus post-execution recheck. Current fixed Git driver equals original BASE bytes.
